serverBaseUrl.description: Remote ATEL MCP public base URL

sdkDistPath.description: Path to ATEL SDK dist entry used for serializePayload

naclPath.description: Path to tweetnacl runtime used for DID signing

scopes.description: Requested OAuth scopes for the MCP bridge

relayListenHost.description: Bind interface for the platform → plugin push listener. Default 0.0.0.0 (all interfaces). Set to 127.0.0.1 to disable external access.

relayListenPort.description: Port for the push listener. Default 3101 (avoids the SDK-era 3100). If bind fails (port taken / NAT), plugin falls back to pull mode automatically.

relayPublicUrl.description: Public-reachable URL the platform should POST events to (e.g. https://lobster.example.com/atel-relay). If unset, plugin auto-detects via api.ipify.org. Falls back to pull mode if neither works.

relayHmacSecret.description: Optional shared secret matching platform's RELAY_PUSH_HMAC_SECRET. When set, plugin verifies X-Atel-Push-Hmac on inbound pushes; mismatches are rejected.
